Game Overview

Space Wars puts players into a shooter experience centered on pilot your spaceship through relentless alien waves, dodging attacks while your guns fire automatically. Gather coins, harness powerful boosts, and upgrade your ship to extend your survival. Challenge yourself to achieve the ultimate high score and claim the title of galaxy's finest pilot!

How to Play

Playing Space Wars comes down to a simple loop. Pilot your spaceship through relentless alien waves, dodging attacks while your guns fire automatically. Gather coins, harness powerful boosts, and upgrade your ship to extend your survival. Challenge yourself to achieve the ultimate high score and claim the title of galaxy's finest pilot!
